issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the introductory phrase 'και ειπεν αυτοις' (and he said to them).

The Greek 'ουτως γεγραπται και ουτως εδει παθειν' implies a sequence/correspondence ('thus it is written and thus [it was] necessary...'). The Vietnamese 'Có lời chép rằng' (It is written that...) misses the 'ouτως' (thus) repetition which links the writing to the necessity of the suffering.
